trailhead.label: On the Unterrungger Straße at the hamlet of Rader, below Lüsen

cautions: About 2.5 km of mountain path (T2) across the slope: narrow and uneven in places, so keep your dog close and watch its footing.
About 1.45 km on quiet asphalt lanes (the Unterrungger Straße and the Berger Straße), where a car may pass: keep your dog on a short lead.
160 m on the Lüsener Straße through the village and a crossing of the Petschieder Straße: keep your dog close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.On the Unterrungger Straße at the hamlet: Sulla Via Unterrungg presso la frazione di Rader, sotto Luson
textIt.About 2.5 km of mountain path (T2) acros: Circa 2,5 km di sentiero di montagna (T2) lungo il pendio: stretto e irregolare in alcuni punti, quindi tieni il cane vicino e fai attenzione a dove mette le zampe.
textIt.About 1.45 km on quiet asphalt lanes (th: Circa 1,45 km su stradine asfaltate tranquille (Via Unterrungg e Via Berg), dove può passare un’auto: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.160 m on the Lüsener Straße through the: 160 m sulla Via Luson in paese e un attraversamento della Via Petschied: tieni il cane vicino.
